postCreateCommand: set -euo pipefail; npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code && cargo install wasm-pack && cd web && npm install; cd - >/dev/null; curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; uv tool install claude-swap; cswap --help >/dev/null
postStartCommand: bash -lc 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; if command -v cswap >/dev/null; then echo "claude-swap present"; else echo "⚠ claude-swap missing"; fi; if [ -n "$ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" ]; then echo "Claude key present"; else echo "⚠ Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or run claude login"; fi'
